title: THE ANATOMY OF A COMPROMISED ARCHITECTURE: LUCID’S SECRETS ARE UNRAVELED
description: We have observed that you have chosen to hide behind your silence while assuring your shareholders that “everything is under control.” You appear to believe that by remaining silent and buying time, the value of the stolen data will gradually diminish. You have miscalculated. We have no intention of burning all of our leverage at once. We understand how to play chess.
